Test Objective: Verify the login page renders the expected controls and initial focus.
Author: TBD
Preconditions: Authorized test environment and build are available; login page URL is confirmed.

Test Data: Approved login URL; no account data required.
Expected Result: The login page renders without missing or overlapping controls; email and password fields, remember-me option, sign-in action, and available registration/recovery links are visible; initial focus is on the first input field as specified.

Test Objective: Verify that clicking each form label focuses its associated control.
Author: TBD

Expected Result: Each label activates and focuses its matching input; input is associated with its accessible label.

Test Objective: Verify keyboard-only access to all login-page controls.
Author: TBD
Preconditions: Login page is open; keyboard is available; an authorized test account exists for the final sign-in step.

Expected Result: Focus order is logical and visible; every interactive control is reachable and operable without a pointer; focus does not become trapped; activation produces the expected action.

Test Objective: Verify form controls and validation feedback are perceivable to a screen reader.

Test Data: Approved screen reader; malformed email placeholder if validation is triggered.
Expected Result: Controls have meaningful accessible names and roles; validation feedback is announced and associated with the relevant field; no control is omitted from assistive navigation.

Test Objective: Verify email format validation on the specified interaction.
Author: TBD

Expected Result: Malformed input receives clear field feedback at the specified time; valid-format input does not receive a format error; no account lookup or sign-in is implied by format validation alone.

Test Objective: Verify required-field validation for empty credentials.
Author: TBD

Test Data: Empty values; synthetic valid-format email; non-sensitive test password managed outside this CSV.
Expected Result: Each missing required value is identified with clear feedback; authentication does not succeed; the page remains usable for correction; no sensitive implementation details are exposed.

Test Objective: Verify that incorrect credentials are rejected without revealing account existence.

Expected Result: Authentication is rejected; response is actionable but does not disclose whether an account exists or reveal secrets; no dashboard access is granted.

Test Objective: Verify password-reset request behavior for a controlled test account.
Author: TBD

Test Objective: Verify expired or already-used reset tokens cannot be used.
Author: TBD
Preconditions: Reset token expiry and one-time-use rules are documented; controlled test mailbox and synthetic QA account are available.

Test Data: Expired or previously used reset link from controlled test flow; do not retain token in CSV or general evidence.
Expected Result: Expired or previously used token is rejected; password is not changed through the invalid token; clear recovery instructions are shown; token is not disclosed in error text.

Test Objective: Verify password complexity and length boundaries against the approved policy.
Author: TBD
Preconditions: Product/security has supplied exact password rules and approved test values; password reset or password-change flow is available in non-production.
Manual Execution Steps: 1) Submit a candidate at each documented lower and upper length boundary; 2) Submit candidates just outside each documented boundary; 3) Check required character-category combinations using approved test values; 4) Observe validation and submission outcomes.
Test Data: Boundary candidates generated from the approved password policy; do not record actual passwords in this file or evidence.
Expected Result: Values satisfying the documented policy are accepted; values outside it are rejected with actionable feedback; behavior matches the exact approved rules. If rules are not supplied, mark Blocked and request clarification.
